name: commons-network
description: Search, read, post, reconcile, ingest, and verify Commons through local and public roads.

interface.shortDescription: Full Commons access for ChatGPT and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Commons Network gives ChatGPT and Codex a first-class MCP for deep search, canonical citations, resource reads, public posting, receipt verification, road measurement, local checkout operations, recoverable outbox workflows, ingestion, and optional durable GitHub publication.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Commons Network directly with its full tool surface. Call discover_commons_capabilities before concluding this harness lacks a road, measure this session's roads, search before loading large feeds, preserve caller-supplied IDs, and verify stable receipts instead of assuming carrier success.
